VBO:0201039.summary: Initially shy in scent-searching classes, Kari Trotsky’s Pomapoo Levi was finding the target scents by his third lesson. Her memoir records daily walks to new places and a charity cruise on Lake Michigan. Swimming was less appealing: he paddled straight to the pool exit. At home, he barked to keep other dogs off his chosen couch space.
VBO:0201039.shortDescription: Trotsky recalled Pomapoo Levi learning scent-searching, enjoying daily outings and barking to defend his couch space.
